questions.Description:
Prepare a bulk carrier ship model as per given specimen.
[Note: ship models should be made of mild steel sheets. The experiments given in this examination are to be done by a group of students. The group may consist of a maximum of six students. The examiner will supply the prepared parts of ship model and ask the candidate to assemble the parts by welding]
